svg.title: Timeline
svg.desc: Timeline of Birch Design Lab as a birch trunk, from the founding on 2026-07-15 and the first pieces live on 2026-07-16, through the Portal merge on 2026-09-23, to the CI verify gate and the contact safety net on 2026-11-17.

text.tspan: BDL-003 Novgorod Letters built, then parked
BDL-004 The Loom built and live
Moved from Cloudflare Pages to Workers
Portal foundation, quiet becomes a school
Six schools built, BDL-010 The Portal merged
CI runs the verify gate on every PR
